directEndpointIdentity.firstPartySource: Coinbase Firecrawl x402 case study, published 2025-08-29
directEndpointIdentity.firstPartyClaim: Firecrawl added this x402-enabled endpoint; pricing is quoted via HTTP 402 and payment settles in USDC on Base.
directEndpointIdentity.benchmarkUse: historical/first-party endpoint identity and protocol expectation; not a current live quote

currentFirstPartyOrdinaryBilling.boundary: ordinary Firecrawl account billing only; must not be substituted for the direct x402 route's live 402 quote

secondaryCompatibilityWarning.claim: Direct Firecrawl x402 endpoint returns HTTP 401 rather than 402 and omits machine-payable payment requirements, making it unusable with the thirdweb payer described by that source.
secondaryCompatibilityWarning.requiredValidation: Fresh unsigned preflight against the exact endpoint must determine current HTTP status, payment challenge fields and executable recipient before any payment attempt.

benchmarkFields.listedPriceProvenance: secondary catalogue / prior public x402 references; not current executable quote

decision.identityRule: Do not merge prices, reliability or payment capability from reseller/gateway Firecrawl routes with api.firecrawl.dev/v1/x402/search.
decision.failureClassification: If exact route returns 401/403 without parseable payment requirements, classify PAYMENT_PROTOCOL_UNAVAILABLE rather than benchmark quality FAIL.
